title: Why clinic websites lose bookings

slides.heading: Your website may be losing bookings
slides.body: A few small issues can make booking harder than it should be.

slides.heading: Visitors need one clear next step
slides.body: If the page asks too much, people often leave before they book.

slides.heading: Slow pages add friction
slides.body: When a site feels heavy, patients may delay the decision and move on.

slides.heading: Trust must show fast
slides.body: People want to see location, services, and contact details right away.
